resourceId.description: hash(rootId, canonicalPath at first observation) — opaque

origin.description: Where this row's knowledge came from. Deliberately an open string, not an enum: resource-scanning-and-caching.md has not yet settled the full non-git-lane taxonomy this column needs to cover.

observed.description: False for a synthetic entity declared by config (e.g. a packaging files: target, or a plugin named in a marketplace manifest) that has never been seen

fromEnumeration.description: False for an entity first discovered during parse (e.g. a resolved link target) and back-filled afterward

vatId.description: VAT-assigned resource id (frontmatter id, or a generated fallback), or null when not yet assigned

projection-resources.description: A row of the path-dependent `resources` table — one entity, zero or more realizations
